# cross_sectional = TRUE: the SHCS trajectories with the cross-sectional calls, read from and written to their own folders

`r if (params$cross_sectional) "**Sensitivity analysis: this run uses the SHCS trajectories that include the cross-sectional calls.** The paths named in the text are those of the main analysis; this run reads and writes the folders cross_sectional under them."`


The SHCS trajectories are matched to SardiNIA trajectories on the curves of
`2_trajectory_models/01_spline_fits.Rmd` (VAF floored at LoD / 2 of the trajectory). The notebook writes
the four sets of the comparison to `resources/LoD/`:

- **unmatched**: all trajectories of the 5 genes;
- **unmatched, age filtered**: the ages that both cohorts cover;
- **matched**: every SHCS trajectory with one SardiNIA trajectory of the same gene, the same variant if possible, and then the widest age range
  around the SHCS trajectory;
- **matched, age filtered**: the ages that the two trajectories of a pair have in common.

# Load the data

```{r}
main_genes <- c("DNMT3A", "TET2", "ASXL1", "PPM1D", "TP53")

shcs_all <- read.table(file.path(resources_lod, "SHCS_predicted_trajectories_derivatives.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  rename(Gene = Gene.refGene) %>%
  mutate(ID = as.character(ID), Cohort = "SHCS")

sardinia_all <- read.table(file.path(resources_lod, "Sardinia_predicted_trajectories_derivatives.txt"), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  rename(Gene = Gene.refGene) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = "Sardinia")

shcs_pred_trajectories <- shcs_all %>% filter(Gene %in% main_genes)
sardinia_pred_trajectories <- sardinia_all %>% filter(Gene %in% main_genes)

bind_rows(shcs_pred_trajectories, sardinia_pred_trajectories) %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  summarise(individuals = n_distinct(ID), trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id), `age, range` = paste(range(Age), collapse = "-")) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Matching

The SHCS trajectories are taken one by one (ordered by `traj_id`). Among the SardiNIA trajectories of the same gene not yet used, the one with
the same variant is taken if there is one, and then the one with the largest `min_Age_dif + max_Age_dif`, the years it extends beyond
the SHCS trajectory on either side. `build_sets()` matches and makes the four sets.

```{r}
# age range of each trajectory; `variant`: the name of the variant without the individual, with the gene also for splice variants
traj_sum <- function(pred) {
  pred %>%
    group_by(traj_id) %>%
    summarise(min_Age = min(Age), max_Age = max(Age), Gene = first(Gene), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(variant = sub("^[^:]+:", "", traj_id),
           variant = ifelse(grepl("^NM", variant), paste(Gene, variant, sep = ":"), variant))
}

build_sets <- function(shcs_pred, sard_pred) {
  shcs_sum <- traj_sum(shcs_pred)
  sardinia_sum <- traj_sum(sard_pred)

  shcs_sum$index <- seq_len(nrow(shcs_sum))
  sardinia_sum$matched <- FALSE
  sardinia_matched <- NULL
  shcs_unmatched <- NULL

  for (i in shcs_sum$index) {
    one_traj <- shcs_sum[i, ]
    candidate_traj <- sardinia_sum %>% filter(!matched, Gene == one_traj$Gene)

    if (nrow(candidate_traj) == 0) {
      shcs_unmatched <- rbind(shcs_unmatched, one_traj)
    } else {
      res <- candidate_traj %>%
        mutate(exact_var = as.numeric(variant == one_traj$variant),
               min_Age_dif = -(min_Age - one_traj$min_Age),
               max_Age_dif = max_Age - one_traj$max_Age,
               score = min_Age_dif + max_Age_dif) %>%
        arrange(-exact_var, -score) %>%
        slice(1)
      sardinia_matched <- rbind(sardinia_matched, res %>% select(traj_id, min_Age, max_Age, Gene, variant, exact_var) %>% mutate(index = i))
      sardinia_sum$matched[sardinia_sum$traj_id == res$traj_id] <- TRUE
    }
  }

  pairs <- sardinia_matched %>%
    left_join(shcs_sum %>% select(index, shcs_traj_id = traj_id, shcs_min_Age = min_Age, shcs_max_Age = max_Age), by = "index")

  unmatched <- bind_rows(sard_pred, shcs_pred)

  unmatched_filtered <- unmatched %>%
    group_by(Cohort) %>%
    mutate(min_Age = min(Age), max_Age = max(Age)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(max_min_Age = max(min_Age), min_max_Age = min(max_Age)) %>%
    filter(Age >= max_min_Age & Age <= min_max_Age)

  matched_all <- bind_rows(
    shcs_pred %>% inner_join(shcs_sum %>% select(traj_id, min_Age, max_Age, index), by = "traj_id"),
    sard_pred %>% inner_join(sardinia_matched %>% select(traj_id, min_Age, max_Age, index), by = "traj_id"))

  # an SHCS trajectory without a partner has no pair to compare and stays out of the matched sets
  matched <- matched_all %>% filter(index %in% sardinia_matched$index)

  matched_filtered <- matched %>%
    group_by(index) %>%
    mutate(min_Age_both = max(min_Age), max_Age_both = min(max_Age)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(Age >= min_Age_both & Age <= max_Age_both)

  list(sets = list(unmatched = unmatched, `unmatched, age filtered` = unmatched_filtered, matched = matched, `matched, age filtered` = matched_filtered),
       pairs = pairs, n_shcs_without_partner = if (is.null(shcs_unmatched)) 0L else nrow(shcs_unmatched), n_sardinia_left = sum(!sardinia_sum$matched))
}

set_table <- function(sets) {
  imap_dfr(sets, function(d, name) {
    d %>%
      group_by(Cohort) %>%
      summarise(set = name, trajectories = n_distinct(traj_id), `curve points` = n(), `age, range` = paste(range(Age), collapse = "-"),
                `age, median` = median(Age), .groups = "drop")
  }) %>%
    relocate(set) %>%
    knitr::kable()
}

res_main <- build_sets(shcs_pred_trajectories, sardinia_pred_trajectories)

res_main$pairs %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(pairs = n(), `same variant` = sum(exact_var),
            `SardiNIA trajectory covers the SHCS ages` = sum(min_Age <= shcs_min_Age & max_Age >= shcs_max_Age),
            `ages in common, none` = sum(pmin(max_Age, shcs_max_Age) < pmax(min_Age, shcs_min_Age)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  bind_rows(summarise(., Gene = "All", across(where(is.numeric), sum))) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Matched pairs")

c(SHCS_trajectories_without_a_partner = res_main$n_shcs_without_partner, SardiNIA_trajectories_left = res_main$n_sardinia_left)
```

# The four sets

```{r}
sets <- res_main$sets
unmatched <- sets$unmatched
matched <- sets$matched

set_table(sets)
```

Curves of the four sets on a linear scale, and of the unmatched set with the VAF on a log scale, which shows the part near the LoD:

```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
hiv_colors <- c("SHCS" = "red3", "Sardinia" = "grey44")

for (name in names(sets)) {
  print(sets[[name]] %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = VAF, group = traj_id, color = Cohort)) +
          geom_line() +
          scale_color_manual(values = hiv_colors) +
          theme_classic() +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0.02, linetype = "dashed") +
          facet_wrap(~Gene) +
          ggtitle(name))
}

sets$unmatched %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = VAF, group = traj_id, color = Cohort)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values = hiv_colors) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.02, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Gene) +
  ggtitle("unmatched, log scale")
```

```{r, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
for (v in c("VAF_speed", "VAF_acceleration")) {
  print(bind_rows(unmatched %>% mutate(set = "unmatched"), matched %>% mutate(set = "matched")) %>%
          mutate(set = factor(set, levels = c("unmatched", "matched"))) %>%
          ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = .data[[v]], group = traj_id, color = Cohort)) +
          geom_line() +
          scale_color_manual(values = hiv_colors) +
          theme_classic() +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
          facet_grid(set ~ Gene))
}
```

# Write the result

```{r}
write_sets <- function(sets, suffix = "") {
  files <- c(`unmatched` = "unmatched", `unmatched, age filtered` = "unmatched_age_filtered", matched = "matched", `matched, age filtered` = "matched_age_filtered")
  for (name in names(files)) {
    write.table(sets[[name]], file.path(resources_lod, paste0("SHCS_Sardinia_", files[[name]], "_trajectories", suffix, ".txt")), sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
  }
}

write_sets(sets)
```


# All genes

The same sets are made for the trajectories of all genes and written with the suffix `_all_genes`. The 5-gene sets are the main analysis
(Figure 4, Figures S11-S18).

```{r}
res_all <- build_sets(shcs_all, sardinia_all)

set_table(res_all$sets)
write_sets(res_all$sets, "_all_genes")
```
